title: Google Hotels prices input
description: Search Google Hotels by place ("hotels in Paris"), by hotel name, or by Google Hotels link, for your dates and guests. Optionally load every booking site's price (Booking.com, Expedia, the hotel's own site...).

queries.title: Searches
queries.description: What you would type into Google Hotels, one per line: a city, district or landmark, e.g. "hotels in Paris", "hotels near Times Square", "Lisbon Alfama". Each search returns up to "Max hotels per search".

hotelNames.title: Hotel names
hotelNames.description: Specific hotels to look up by name, e.g. "Hotel Lutetia Paris". Add the city for best matching. The best-matching result is returned (hotels without a confident match are skipped and listed in the log).

hotelUrls.title: Google Hotels links
hotelUrls.description: Links to hotels on Google Hotels (they contain "/travel/hotels/entity/..."), or the entity ID itself (the "entityId" output field). Most reliable way to track the same hotels every day.

checkInDate.title: Check-in date
checkInDate.description: Check-in date as YYYY-MM-DD, or relative like "+30 days". Default: 30 days from today.

checkOutDate.title: Check-out date
checkOutDate.description: Check-out date as YYYY-MM-DD, or relative like "+32 days". If empty, check-out = check-in + "Nights".

nights.title: Nights
nights.description: Length of stay used when no check-out date is given (1-30).

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult guests (1-12). Prices depend on it.

children.title: Children
children.description: Number of children (0-8). With children, searches use Google's internal search endpoint, which accepts child ages.

childrenAges.title: Children's ages
childrenAges.description: One age (0-17) per child, e.g. ["5", "9"]. If empty, every child is treated as 8 years old.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: 3-letter currency code for all prices, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, MDL, RON.

includeOffers.title: Include prices of every booking site
includeOffers.description: Also load each hotel's offers list: Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Hotels.com, the hotel's official site and 30+ others, with price, price with taxes, official-site and sponsored flags and link. Needs one extra request per hotel and is charged as an extra event.

maxOffersPerHotel.title: Max offers per hotel
maxOffersPerHotel.description: Keep only the N cheapest offers per hotel. 0 = keep all.

minPrice.title: Min price per night
minPrice.description: Skip hotels cheaper than this per night (in the chosen currency, before taxes, as shown on Google). Hotels without a price are skipped when a price filter is set.

maxPrice.title: Max price per night
maxPrice.description: Skip hotels more expensive than this per night (in the chosen currency, before taxes, as shown on Google).

minRating.title: Min guest rating
minRating.description: Only hotels with at least this Google guest rating (out of 5).

hotelClass.title: Hotel class (stars)
hotelClass.description: Only hotels with these official star classes. Empty = any. Hotels without a class are skipped when set.

maxHotelsPerQuery.title: Max hotels per search
maxHotelsPerQuery.description: Stop each search after this many hotels (after filters). Google shows about 18-20 hotels per page.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max result pages per search
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Safety limit on result pages read per search (about 18-20 hotels each), useful with strict filters.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google interface language (hl), e.g. "en", "de", "fr". Affects hotel class texts and descriptions.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country the search is made from (gl), 2 letters, e.g. "us", "gb", "de". Google shows prices and taxes the way travelers from this country see them.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Google blocks datacenter IPs quickly. The default Apify proxy works for small runs; each retry uses a new IP, and the browser fallback helps. The Apify RESIDENTIAL and GOOGLE_SERP groups are not available in this Actor: if selected, the run uses the default Apify proxy instead. For residential or other IPs, use your own proxy URLs. The free plan's shared datacenter IPs work only for small runs and often get "unusual traffic" pages.

useBrowser.title: Real browser
useBrowser.description: "fallback": fast HTTP requests first; if Google blocks them or shows a consent page, switch to a real Chrome browser for the rest of the run. "always": use the browser from the start (slower, more memory). "never": HTTP only.

searchMethod.title: Search method
searchMethod.description: Advanced. "auto": the search results page, with Google's internal RPC endpoint as a backup (and first choice when children are set). "page" or "rpc" force one method.

maxRetries.title: Retries per request
maxRetries.description: How many times a blocked or failed request is retried, each time with a new session and proxy IP.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel offer requests
maxConcurrency.description: How many hotels' offers are loaded at the same time. Lower is gentler on Google (fewer blocks).

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for one request to Google.

saveDebugPages.title: Save debug pages
saveDebugPages.description: When Google returns something unexpected (captcha, consent, no data), save up to 5 of those responses to the key-value store (keys DEBUG-...) so they can be inspected.

baseUrl.title: Base URL (testing)
baseUrl.description: For testing only: send all requests to this address instead of https://www.google.com (e.g. a local mock server). Leave empty.
